name: Goods Hunt - Shopping Hole
description:
Welcome to Goods Hunt!

A physics-based puzzle where your shopping cart transforms into an absorbing collector. Navigate supermarket aisles, gather everyday items, and watch them stack infinitely high before collapsing spectacularly.

INFINITELY SATISFYING
Complete your shopping list and trigger a breathtaking collapse animation. Realistic physics makes each tower crumble uniquely. 

YOUR HOLE CART SIZE UP GRADUALLY 
Start with a small absorption hole. Eat small items first to expand your hole size. The bigger you grow, the larger items you can hunt. This creates natural progression where impossible items become achievable as you progress. Strategic thinking determines collection order.

THEMED COLLECTIONS
Unlock cup collections as you progress through levels. Discover themes like Fruits, Bakery, Aquatic, Candy Land, Beverages, and more. Each theme features multiple cups to collect during gameplay. Complete entire collections to earn exclusive rewards including coins, boosters, and special bonuses.

CONTINUOUS EVENTS
- Key Hunt challenges you to collect golden keys scattered throughout levels. Unlock treasure chests containing rare items and exclusive cups. 
- Chugging Treasure brings limited-time collectible milk appearing in each level.
- Star Contest offers weekly competition on global leaderboards where top performers earn legendary recognition. 
- Cloud Quest provides themed challenge chains - complete quests to unlock entire collection sets instantly.

We regularly add new events and exclusive content keeping gameplay fresh.

YOUR SUPERMARKET ADVENTURE
Familiar aisles, recognizable products, everyday items you see in the supermarket - but with an addictive twist and cute design.

The most satisfying feeling comes when items stack infinitely high inside your cart. It's the comforting familiarity of shopping combined with incredibly rewarding gameplay.

PROGRESSION
Unlock themes at level milestones, we have various collections for you to discover. Collect boosters through gameplay and events - Magnet attracts nearby items automatically, Freeze Time pauses countdowns for planning, Compass reveals hidden shopping list items.

FAMILIAR SUPERMARKET ITEMS
Recognizable supermarket products create immediate connection. Everyday goods from real shopping trips make collecting fun and relaxing. This familiarity makes the experience oddly satisfying.

IDEAL FOR
Collection completionists hunting themed sets. Event participants enjoying rotating challenges. Casual players seeking relaxing puzzles. Competitive players climbing leaderboards. Anyone appreciating visual and audio feedback.

HOW TO PLAY
Drag the hole through aisles absorbing goods strategically. Eat small items to increase size. Complete objectives before time expires. Gather cups during gameplay. Finish collections for rewards.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at support@lihuhugames.com. 

Download Goods Hunt and start your infinite stacking adventure today!
